title: Chapter Lead Firewall & Software Defined Networking
full_description:
Rotterdam, Netherlands
€6.500,60 - €10.389,47
For our chapter on Firewall & Software Defined Networking (SDN), we are seeking an IT Chapter Lead with experience in network engineering and/or operations. This role will help us develop, maintain, and improve our datacenter network infrastructure.
In your role as a Chapter Lead, you will guide your chapter based on the common purpose you establish. You will coach and develop your fellow engineers to help them and yourself achieve the best every day.
The chapter on Firewall and Software Defined Networking comprises highly skilled engineers with extensive knowledge of network infrastructure. We are seeking a candidate who can enhance the quality, resilience, reliability, and automation of our firewall and SDN services.
Roles and responsibilities
You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving the Firewall and SDN infrastructure. You will be part of the MT of the DC&N Networks Area and will work in close cooperation with the Product Manager responsible for Firewall and SDN.
We hire intelligent individuals like you for your potential. Our main expectation is that you remain curious. Continue learning and take on responsibility. In return, we will support you in becoming an even more remarkable version of yourself.
To perform your best in this job, we expect your backpack to contain:
Expert-level network engineering and operations; experience with firewalls and SDN
